sk.show_portals_hint: Mark ACTIVE hazard Portals on the large map. Removed once a portal closes.
sk.show_levers_hint: Mark the un-activated Sanctum lever on the large map. Removed once pulled.
sk.show_crystals_hint: Death-crystal (HourglassLethal) collection route + markers on the map overlay.
sk.follow_walkable_hint: On: route follows the walkable path like Radar. Off: straight lines.
sk.room_id_gap_hint: Crystals of one room share contiguous entity ids; a larger gap = another room. Only the player's room is routed.
sk.room_margin_hint: Route shows only when the player is within the crystal room's bounding box + this margin. Prevents it appearing from an adjacent room.
sk.mark_best_chests_hint:
In the reward room, marks the best chests on the large map. For each key
tier it highlights the top-N chests by content priority, where N = your live
Bronze/Silver/Gold key count.
sk.content_priority_hint:
Tick a type to track it; higher in the list = higher priority.
Un-tick types you don't want marked (to track only a few, un-tick the rest).
Use the arrows to reorder.
sk.weights_hint: Higher = more desirable. Drag to adjust (Ctrl+click to type). Saved to config.
sk.avoid_honour_restore: Avoid honour restore when honour above
